name: Necromancer: Winds of Northrend deepens Lichfrost's slow from 35% to 50% (#1823)
contract: Winds of Northrend 301333 (CharacterAdvancement 33733, Class tab, class 23) reads 'Increases the amount slowed by Lichfrost by $s1%.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3), EffectBasePoints -16 + DieSides 1 = -15, class mask (0, 0, 0x8000000) in SpellFamilyName 29, which matches every Lichfrost rank (801722 and 501969-501980, family flags 0, 0, 0x8000000). Lichfrost rank 1 801722 has no SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS; its effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED (33) with EffectBasePoints -36 + DieSides 1 = -35 ('slowing their movement speed by $s3%'). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue applies the caster's SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 to effect 2, and the Necromancer contracts leave aura 107 alone, so the slow becomes -35 + -15 = -50. The audit's premise (no source reference to 301333) does not apply to native aura types. Lichfrost's slow must be -35 on the target before the talent and -50 after it.
